### Strategy Details

```{python}
#| label: display-all-strategies
for cur_key in B:
    cur_s = B[cur_key]
    print(f"## {cur_s['name']} (`{cur_s['cls']}`)")
    print(f"**File:** `{cur_s['file']}` · **Type:** {cur_s['type']}")
    print(f"*{cur_s['summary']}*")
    if cur_s.get("formula"):
        print(f"\n**Core Formula:** `{cur_s['formula']}`")
    if cur_s.get("features"):
        print(f"\n**Features:** {cur_s['features']}")
    print("\n**Pros:**")
    for p_item in cur_s["pros"]:
        print(f"- ✅ {p_item}")
    print("\n**Cons:**")
    for c_item in cur_s["cons"]:
        print(f"- ⚠️ {c_item}")
    print(f"\n**Best for:** *{cur_s['best_for']}*")
    score_keys = ["ndcg", "map", "mrr", "p1", "latency_ms", "p50_ms", "qps", "bm25_uplift", "recall", "precision", "f1", "accuracy"]
    stats = {sk: sv for sk, sv in cur_s.items() if sk in score_keys and sv is not None}
    if stats:
        print("\n**Benchmark Stats:**")
        for sk_name, sv_val in stats.items():
            sk_label = sk_name.replace("_", " ").title()
            if isinstance(sv_val, float):
                print(f"- **{sk_label}:** `{sv_val:.4f}`" if sv_val < 10 else f"- **{sk_label}:** `{sv_val:,.0f}`")
            else:
                print(f"- **{sk_label}:** `{sv_val}`")
    print()
```

## Pareto Frontier: Quality vs Speed

```{python}
#| label: plot-pareto
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib import patheffects

_keys = ["bm25", "colbert", "distilled", "cascade", "hybrid", "binary"]
_pdata = [(B[k]["name"], B[k]["ndcg"], B[k]["latency_ms"]) for k in _keys]
_fig, _ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
_colors = ["#888888", "#4A90D9", "#50C878", "#FFB347", "#E8575A", "#9B59B6"]
for (_name, _ndcg, _lat), _c in zip(_pdata, _colors):
    _size = 150 + (_ndcg * 300) if _ndcg else 80
    _ax.scatter(_lat, _ndcg, c=_c, s=_size, label=_name, edgecolors="white", linewidth=1.5, zorder=5)
    _ax.annotate(_name, (_lat, _ndcg), textcoords="offset points", xytext=(8, 6 if _name != "BM25" else -14), fontsize=9, path_effects=[patheffects.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground="white")])
_ax.set_xlabel("Latency (ms) ← faster")
_ax.set_ylabel("NDCG@10 → better ↑")
_ax.set_title("Pareto Frontier: Quality vs Speed")
_ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
_ax.set_xlim(-0.2, max(d[2] for d in _pdata) * 1.25)
_ax.set_ylim(0, 0.28)
_fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Latency Scaling with Corpus Size

```{python}
#| label: plot-scaling
SCALING = [
    (20, 0.07, 1.10, 0.33, 0.05),
    (50, 0.07, 0.92, 0.30, 0.05),
    (100, 0.06, 0.86, 0.28, 0.04),
    (200, 0.06, 0.86, 0.25, 0.04),
]
_fig, _ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
_sizes = [s[0] for s in SCALING]
_ax.plot(_sizes, [s[1] for s in SCALING], "o-", label="BM25")
_ax.plot(_sizes, [s[2] for s in SCALING], "s-", label="Hybrid")
_ax.plot(_sizes, [s[3] for s in SCALING], "^-", label="ColBERT")
_ax.plot(_sizes, [s[4] for s in SCALING], "D-", label="Binary")
_ax.set_xlabel("Corpus Size (documents)")
_ax.set_ylabel("Latency (ms)")
_ax.set_title("Latency Scaling with Corpus Size")
_ax.legend()
_ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
_fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Ranking Quality by Strategy

```{python}
#| label: plot-quality-bars
_keys_with_ndcg = [k for k in B if B[k].get("ndcg") is not None]
_names = [B[k]["name"] for k in _keys_with_ndcg]
_ndcgs = [B[k]["ndcg"] for k in _keys_with_ndcg]
_colors = ["#9B59B6", "#E8575A", "#50C878", "#FFB347", "#4A90D9", "#888888"]
_fig, _ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.5))
_bars = _ax.barh(_names, _ndcgs, color=_colors, edgecolor="white", height=0.6)
for _bar, _val in zip(_bars, _ndcgs):
    _ax.text(_bar.get_width() + 0.005, _bar.get_y() + _bar.get_height() / 2, f"{_val:.4f}", va="center", fontsize=9)
_ax.set_xlabel("NDCG@10")
_ax.set_title("Ranking Quality by Strategy")
_ax.set_xlim(0, max(_ndcgs) * 1.3)
_ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis="x")
_fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Key Findings

- **Best quality:** Hybrid Fusion — NDCG@10=0.2000, MRR=0.2000, P@1=0.2000
- **Fastest:** Binary Quantized — 22,866 QPS at 0.04ms p50
- **Best trade-off:** Binary Quantized — matches hybrid quality at 22x lower latency
- **Consistency:** Consistency Engine — perfect recall/precision/F1 on synthetic
- **Pairwise:** Distilled Pairwise — 100% pairwise accuracy at 0.10ms per comparison
- **Scaling:** All strategies scale sub-linearly; BM25 & Binary are near-constant regardless of corpus size
- **Embedder:** potion-base-8M at dim=64 achieves same NDCG as 32M at dim=512
